summary: Allbirds, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose entry into a Class A Common Stock Sales Agreement with Chardan Capital Markets LLC for an at-the-market (ATM) offering. The terms allow Allbirds to sell shares from time to time, with Chardan receiving a commission of up to 3% of gross proceeds. The filing also notes termination of the prior ATM agreement with TD Securities. This is a routine capital-raising arrangement, not a special situation. No special-situation event; the filing is a standard current report on a material definitive agreement for an ATM facility.
